async function craftOneIronPickaxe(bot) {
    // This routine checks if the bot already possesses an iron pickaxe; if so, it stops. It then verifies that the bot has at least three iron ingots and two sticks. The function searches for a crafting table within a 32-block radius. If a crafting table is found, it attempts to craft one iron pickaxe. Finally, it confirms that the pickaxe was successfully added to the inventory.
}
